Name: Blood Magic - NPC Expansion
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[center][b][color=#cc0000][size=6][u]Blood Magic[/u][/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#cc0000][size=4]Power demands sacrifice. [/size][/color][/b][/center]
[left][/left]
[size=4]Something ancient is stirring beneath Stardew Valley.[/size]

[size=4]What begins as an invitation to experiment with forbidden rituals gradually becomes something much more sinister. Strange dreams interrupt your sleep. Hooded figures appear where no one should be standing. The Wizard grows increasingly concerned, and a mysterious researcher named Dr. Aldric Voss arrives in town and suspects that the valley is hiding a history far older than anyone realizes.[/size]

[b][size=4]Most things are explained here, please read everything. Most questions are answered in the FAQ section below.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]***Trigger Warning*** This mod contains images and content that some might find scary including: occult symbolism, supernatural horror elements, some pretty benign jump scares, use of blood/life force as fuel for the magic system. Most of these things can be toggled off in the config menu.***[/size][/b]

[size=5][b][u]Description[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Blood Magic is a dark fantasy and cosmic horror expansion featuring an extensive magic system focused on trading HP for powerful buffs, a new NPC, custom locations, a branching progression of forbidden knowledge, and a complete story culminating in a challenging boss encounter.[/size]

[size=4]The deeper you venture into the magic, the more power you gain. But power comes with a cost. [/size]

[size=5][b][u]The Dark Tome[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Your journey is guided by the Dark Tome, an ancient book containing ritual instructions and forbidden knowledge. You receive the book in the mail from a mysterious benefactor upon reaching level 4 combat.  The Tome serves as an interactive reference that evolves as you progress. New pages become available as you learn additional rituals, encounter supernatural phenomena, and discover the truth behind the valley's forgotten history.[/size]

[size=5][b][u]A New NPC[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Meet and befriend Dr. Aldric Voss, a forensic alchemist investigating unusual phenomena throughout the valley. Aldric has his own campsite, daily routines, dialogue, and friendship events. As your relationship develops, he becomes increasingly involved in understanding the origins of the old powers of the valley.[/size]

[size=4]His storyline includes:[/size]

[size=4]- 10 heart events plus additional story and quest related events.  [/size]
[size=4]- Research into ancient artifacts and forgotten rituals.[/size]
[size=4]- Investigations connected to your supernatural experiences.[/size]
[size=4]- New dialogue that responds to the unfolding mystery.[/size]
[size=4]- A complete character arc extending into the story's aftermath.[/size]

[size=4]Aldric plays an important role in the main narrative, and developing your friendship with him is essential to uncovering its deepest secrets and progressing further into the story and even performing some of the rituals you will receive. [/size]

[size=5][b][u]New Machines[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]- [u]Sacrificial Altar:[/u] provide the right items once you've reached the necessary skill levels to perform rituals with varying power levels and buffs. There are 3 tiers of rituals that open up as your progress through the story and perform more rituals. You will accumulate Blood Debt along the way as your perform these rituals. Power always has a price. Will you let it drive you mad?[/size]

[size=4]- [u]Blood Essence Harvester:[/u] Insert a void essence and give some of your life essence to produce a vial of Blood Essence - a required regent for all of your rituals. [/size]

[size=5][b][u]Blood Debt[/u][/b][/size][size=4]

Your actions have consequences. Performing rituals gradually accumulates Blood Debt, a measure of your growing connection to forces that should remain undisturbed. This is displayed in the bottom left of the screen. 

As your debt increases, you will experience:

- Increasingly disturbing dreams.
- Visions of mysterious cultists appearing and disappearing around the valley.
- Supernatural visual disturbances and jump scares.
- Ritual miscasts and curses.
- New story developments and forbidden knowledge.
- All of these are configurable for a slightly cozier experience.[/size]
[size=4]-Eating a lucky lunch will decrease your blood debt by 1 but can only be done once per day.

Blood Debt is closely integrated into the story and your progression as a practitioner of dark magic. The maximum miscast chance is capped at 15%, and the difficulty can be adjusted in the configuration menu.[/size]

[spoiler]
[size=4]After defeating the boss, the wizard will give you a special ritual to wipe out your blood debt while keeping all of the rituals you learned and the ability to cast them without re-accumulating more blood debt. You'll be free from the Unending's grasp.[/size][/spoiler]


[size=5][u][b]New Locations[/b][/u][/size]

[size=4]Enter Aldric's camp near the traveling merchant and learn why he's really here in Pelican Town. [/size]
[size=4]Explore a hidden temple only reachable after learning a unique ritual. [/size]
[size=4]Custom final encounter arena - meet The Unending and face the true power beneath in the valley. [/size]

[size=5][b][u]Dreams and Supernatural Events[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Experience a series of unsettling dream sequences that gradually reveal the history of Blood Magic. These dreams are connected to your rituals, Blood Debt, and relationships with the characters involved in the mystery. The dreams become increasingly disturbing as the story progresses, eventually revealing why something ancient has taken an interest in you.[/size]

[size=5][b][u]New Dialogue[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]The townsfolk will react to the farmer as you progress through the story. As you plunge deeper into power and madness they will notice the changes in you. [/size]

[size=5][u][b]Getting Started[/b][/u][/size]

[size=4]After reaching Combat Level 4, you will receive a mysterious letter. The letter provides your Dark Tome and the knowledge needed to craft your first ritual equipment.[/size]

[size=4]Read the Tome, build the Altar and Blood Essence Harvester and begin experimenting.[/size]

[size=4]As you progress, pay attention to letters, dreams, new Tome entries, and the people who seem unusually interested in your activities.[/size]

[size=4]This is a story-driven mod. Some rituals, locations, and events are intentionally unavailable until their narrative requirements have been completed.[/size]

[size=5][b][u]F.A.Q.'s[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Q: Does this mod use AI?[/size]
[size=4]A: No AI was used to create this mod. Fellowclown was kind enough to create the art for the main NPC's and the cultists, I did the rest of the art myself. Community assets were used that had open permissions, and nothing was vibe coded. This was a labor of love. [/size]

[size=4]Q: How do I get started?[/size]
[size=4]A: Reach level 4 combat to start the storyline. [/size]

[size=4]Q: Will Aldric be marriageable? [/size]
[size=4]A: No, there's enough people to marry in this game. [/size]

[size=4]Q: I'm stuck how do I progress?[/size]
[size=4]A: Check the Dark Tome. [/size]

[size=4]Q: I have lost the dark tome...what do I do?[/size]
[size=4]A: Don't lose it. You only get one. [/size]

[size=4]Q: Mod XYZ conflicts with Aldric's camp entrance. Will you make a new one?[/size]
[size=4]A: This game is already pretty crowded. I'm not sure where else to put the entrance. IF something does conflict, you may just have to make a choice. Sorry. [/size]

[size=4]Q: Is this safe to install mid-save?[/size]
[size=4]A: 100%[/size]

[size=4]Q: What UI interface are you using? [/size]
[size=4]A: Adventurer's UI Interface[/size]

[size=4]Q: What outfit mod are you using?[/size]
[size=4]A: It's a custom piece made by Lune. She does wonderful work and I highly recommend her. [/size]

[size=4]Q: Can I translate this?[/size]
[size=4]A: Totally[/size]

[size=5][b][u]Configuration[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Blood Magic is fully configurable depending on the kind of experience you want. Make your dark magic journey punishing or as whimsy as possible (all things considered). [/size]

[size=4]Using Generic Mod Config Menu, you can customize:[/size]

[size=4]-Blood Debt accumulation and consequences.[/size]
[size=4]-Whether ritual curses are enabled.[/size]
[size=4]-Miscast probabilities, capped at 15%.[/size]
[size=4]-Supernatural jumpscares and cultist sightings.[/size]
[size=4]-Frequency of paranormal encounters.[/size]
[size=4]-Boss health, damage, and attack behavior.[/size]
[size=4]-Boss arena brightness.[/size]
[size=4]-Overall difficulty presets.[/size]

[size=4]Players who prefer the story without severe penalties can reduce or disable many of the more punishing and scary mechanics.[/size]

[size=4][b]***Important: If you disable Blood Debt consequences but still want to complete the story, keep the option to accumulate Blood Debt for progression enabled***[/b][/size]

[size=5][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Stardew Valley 1.6[/size]
[size=4]SMAPI 4.0 or newer[/size]
[size=4]Content Patcher[/size]
[size=4]Unlockable Bundles[/size]
[size=4]Parchment[/size]
[size=4]Cherry Lake Tilesheet [/size]
[size=4]MiniKarma's Seasonal Tent Recolors feat Interior[/size]

[size=4]Optional:[/size]

[size=4]Generic Mod Config Menu — for in-game configuration[/size]
[size=4]Alchemistry — for additional alchemical integration[/size]

[size=5][b][u]Installation[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]-Install SMAPI and all required dependencies.[/size]
[size=4]-Download and extract Blood Magic.[/size]
[size=4]-Place both the Blood Magic and [CP] Blood Magic folders in your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/size]
[size=4]-Launch the game through SMAPI.[/size]

[size=5][b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Blood Magic is designed for Stardew Valley 1.6, with support for the vanilla game and Stardew Valley Expanded.[/size]

[size=4]The mod adds custom locations and modifies part of Cindersap Forest to provide access to Aldric's camp. Other mods that extensively alter the same area may require compatibility patches.[/size]
[size=4]There is built in compatibility with Alchemistry. If you have this mod installed there are a few extra rituals and dialogue included. [/size]

[size=5][b][u]Content Warning[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Blood Magic contains elements of cosmic horror, occult imagery, blood sacrifice, disturbing dreams, supernatural threats, unsettling dialogue, and occasional jumpscares.[/size]

[size=4]Players sensitive to sudden horror imagery can disable Jumpscares in the configuration menu.[/size]

[size=5][b][u]A Note on Progression[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Blood Magic is intended to unfold gradually.[/size]

[size=4]Some events depend on friendship levels, completed rituals, previous dreams, Blood Debt, and particular story milestones.[/size]

[size=4]If you encounter a period where nothing new appears to be happening, check your Dark Tome, review recent letters, and continue developing your relationship with Aldric.[/size]

[size=4]There is no need to rush. Some things have been waiting beneath the valley for centuries. They can wait a little longer.[/size]
